questions.question: What is the index of the first element in a Python list?
questions.explanation_incorrect: Python uses 0-based indexing for all collections.

questions.question: What does negative index [-1] access in a list?
options: The very last item in the list
questions.correct_answer: The very last item in the list
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! Negative indices count backward from the end, with -1 being the last item.
questions.explanation_incorrect: [-1] retrieves the last item of a sequence.

questions.question: Which function returns the total number of items in a list?
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! len() returns the length of lists, strings, and dictionaries.
questions.explanation_incorrect: len() is the standard Python function for length.

questions.question: What happens if you try to access nums[5] on a list with only 3 items?
options: IndexError: list index out of range
questions.correct_answer: IndexError: list index out of range
questions.explanation_correct: Correct! Accessing an index outside the list bounds raises an IndexError.
questions.explanation_incorrect: Out-of-range index lookups raise an IndexError.
